name: verdant-reach-ship-redesign-lab

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:sloop
scripts.test:core: node --expose-gc --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/editor-defaults.test.js tests/editor-interface.test.js tests/editor-persistence.test.js tests/cannon-generator.test.js tests/misc-model-category.test.js tests/ship-redesign.test.js
scripts.test:sloop: npm run test:sloop:reference && npm run test:sloop:geometry && npm run test:sloop:rigging && npm run test:sloop:steering && npm run test:sloop:wind && npm run test:sloop:sails
scripts.test:sloop:reference: node --expose-gc --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="Loguivy homardier|Plan-view offsets|Body-plan sections|The 1866 stern|The fine bow" tests/sloop-reference.test.js
scripts.test:sloop:geometry: node --expose-gc --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="central vivier|transom, rudder, anchors|gaff mainsail remains intact" tests/sloop-reference.test.js
scripts.test:sloop:steering: node --expose-gc --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="Rudder and helm wheel|Aft helm" tests/sloop-reference.test.js

description: Standalone ship design studio with 16 independent vessel geometry generators
